title: ECS Setup Checklist
blurb: IGraphReference · authoring · bake discovery · multi-graph · GetState · debug.

chapters.title: Checklist
chapters.text: To own a Grove graph type you need a graph plus importer, a partial context, authoring that points at Auth not the my graph file, an I Graph Reference, and a system that owns Graph Impl.
chapters.deep: Sample MyGraphGraph MyGraphAuth MyGraphAuthoring MyGraph MyContext MyGraphSystem.

chapters.title: Happy path
chapters.text: Define graph type, import Auth asset, hang Graph Authoring, auto bake system writes blob, I System Get Execution Set Chunk Execute.
chapters.deep: IGraphBaking discovery spawns GraphBakingSystem T. Do not hand-write dual type param baking systems as current API.

chapters.title: Multi-graph
chapters.text: Authoring Buffer bakes many blobs on one entity sharing Grove State. Scope keys with Graph Id and tear down with Remove Graph State.
chapters.deep: GraphAuthoringBuffer. GraphStateUtil RemoveGraphState. Do not clear the whole buffer.

chapters.title: State API and debug
chapters.text: Use Get State extension and Graph State Util. There is no Get Variables on modern contexts. Node Debug attrs are gated by config vars.
chapters.deep: ExecuteNodeDebug DataNodeDebug under UNITY_INCLUDE_INSTRUMENTATION. graph.debug-enabled and graph.debug-selected.
